biEncoderCandidates.rejectedBeforeFullBenchmark: Both available exports (upstream quint8_avx2 and mirror dynamic-int8) output raw last_hidden_state without the required Dense(768->512)+normalize head, verified by probe (inputs [input_ids, attention_mask], outputs [last_hidden_state], dim 768). Mean-pooled hidden states are not distiluse embeddings, so faithful Rust preprocessing is impossible with redistributable portable exports.

reranker.leaderRationale: Leader by the deterministic selection rule on the 2026-08-23 rerun: the only budget-viable candidate under the depth-50/900 ms policy (solo p95 13.4-17.2 ms across three runs), card-multilingual conforming, tuned gamma 8, pairwise 85.00% (459/540) on the held-out partition, NDCG@10 0.9184 vs fused 0.8669. Its measured reference-probe weakness - preferring the verbatim query-echo fragment over the complete schedule - is recorded openly in rerankerPairs and handled by fusion/aggregation, not hidden. NON-selected: blocked-quality-gates plus the 1120.2 MiB approval-band pairing.
reranker.pairFormat: tokenizer pair encoding <s>query</s></s>evidence</s> with LongestFirst truncation across the pair at maxSequenceLength preserving the question and separators

chunkPolicy.selection: 384/64 default window; all three profiles produced identical chunk sets and metrics on the synthetic corpus, so profile choice is cost-driven; sections are separate chunks (merging measurably corrupts reranker scoring); latest-summary-only equals all-labeled-summary-templates because fixtures carry one latest-template summary per meeting

referenceExpectations.note: Platform-neutral reference values RE-RECORDED 2026-08-23 from actual staged-artifact inference on the Windows x64 reference machine (Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX): the benchmark-leader e5-base dynamic-int8 session for embeddings (Xenova/multilingual-e5-base @1ec9243030a27d1a115d5c340572074c125b58b2), plus bge-reranker-base int8, mmarco quint8_avx2 and f32 rerankers. Replays must use the identical batch composition per group because dynamic-int8 activation scales depend on padded batch width.

measuredOutcome.notes: 2026-08-23 canonical release rerun against the approved 1.2R corpus: three reranker candidates were budget-viable and all three were fully evaluated; none passes all gates, so no production pair is selected. Failing gates for every pair: Critical Recall@1 (bge-int8 2/5, mmarco-f32 3/5, mmarco-quint8 2/5) and Critical forbidden contamination 4/6 (the stale-version and cross-section critical cases keep surfacing their forbidden claims through fusion+rerank); the bge pairing additionally fails Reference Recall@1 (rank 2 - it lifts the echo-heavy meeting). Citation/source precision is UNEVALUATED by this simulation and cannot support selection. The conforming leader e5-base-int8+mmarco-quint8 measures 1120.2 MiB (approval band). Reranker solo tail latency varied ~1.6-2.4x across same-day runs with machine state (two earlier runs budget-excluded bge-int8/mmarco-f32; samples retained in rerankerCandidateResults) - a clean-hardware re-probe is required before any future selection. In-run e5-base session RSS delta 552.2 MiB coheres with the isolated probe (+553.3 MiB). Title ablation across the full 15-case reference category: title-independent for bge-int8 and mmarco-quint8, TITLE-DEPENDENT for mmarco-f32.
